integrity: The theorem is supported by an arbitrary-tree proof and supplementary exact integer-arithmetic finite checks. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the completed, classical three-stage, third-order Runge–Kutta step for unit-rate diffusion on finite simple undirected trees with at least three vertices; it does not claim stage positivity, weighted graph extension, or nonlinear positivity.
title: Sharp third-order positivity windows and extremal tree topologies
